- Ran prompt review and routing rules for product-search flow; adjusted rerank threshold and added a fallback route to a smaller quantized variant to reduce cost on high-traffic queries.

- Verified KV/prefix caching improvements reduced token usage on repeated prefixes by ~18% in our sample workload.
